replace_or_add_characters_based_on_regex_match :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map (lambda (regex_if (regex_match $1 $0) $2 $0)) (regex_split '.' $2))))))
description: A function that takes a full string, a substring to replace or add, and a substring to match using regex. It replaces or adds characters in the full string based on whether the regex match is found in the full string.

replace_vowels_with_given_characters :: tsubstr
(regex_or 'a' (regex_or 'e' (regex_or 'i' (regex_or 'o' 'u'))))
description: A function that replaces vowels in a substring with given characters.

replace_concat_with_cdr_split :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_cons (regex_concat $0 $1) (regex_cdr (regex_split '.' $2)))))))
description: A function that replaces the concatenation of two substrings in a full string with the rest of the string after splitting by a delimiter.

replace_or_transform_substrings_based_on_delimiter :: tfullstr -> (tsubstr -> tsubstr) -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_map $0 (regex_split '.' $1)))))
description: A function that replaces or transforms substrings in a full string based on a delimiter.

replace_end_of_string_with_given_substring :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append $0 (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_split '.' $1))))))
description: A function that replaces the end of a full string with a given substring based on a delimiter.

replace_end_of_word_with_given_substrings :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append (regex_concat $0 $1) (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_reverse_cdr (regex_split empty_string $2))))))))
description: A function that replaces the end of a word in a full string with given substrings based on specific conditions.

add_character_after_vowel :: tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (replace_or_transform_substrings_based_on_delimiter $0 (lambda (regex_if (regex_match replace_vowels_with_given_characters $0) (regex_concat $0 $2) $0)))))
description: A function that adds a specific character after each vowel in a given full string.

append_substring_to_end_of_word :: tfullstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (regex_flatten (regex_append $0 (regex_split empty_string $1)))))
description: A function that appends a substring to the end of a word in a full string.

add_character_after_specific_substring :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
(lambda (lambda (lambda (replace_or_add_characters_based_on_regex_match $0 (regex_concat $1 $2) $2))))
description: A function that adds a specific character after a specific substring in a full string.

replace_consonants_with_given_characters_except_vowels :: tsubstr -> tsubstr -> tfullstr -> tfullstr
